content: {"summary":"Read src/orchestrator.ts (artifact formats for agents.json/ledger.jsonl/trace.jsonl), src/types.ts (ContextLedgerEntry, AgentDefinition), src/factory.ts (role naming), src/cli.ts, src/experiment.ts and the existing node:test suite to ground the design. Plan: two new standalone modules (src/registry.ts, src/ledger-csv.ts), a small additive `registry` branch + `--runs` option in src/cli.ts, and two node:test files. No changes required to types.ts/ledger.ts/orchestrator.ts (ContextLedgerEntry is already exported); registry is read-only over run artifacts and only ever emits candidates.","verdict":"n/a","findings":["Artifact formats confirmed: orchestrator writes agents.json (array of AgentDefinition with system_prompt dropped by JSON.stringify(undefined), so treat the loaded shape as Partial/Omit<AgentDefinition,'system_prompt'>), ledger.jsonl (one ContextLedgerEntry per line), trace.jsonl (one TraceEvent per line).","Role attribution is available two ways: agents.json gives agent_id -> role and node_id -> role; ledger rows carry agent_id; trace node.completed/node.failed carry node_id. So: invocations/cost/tokens join via agent_id, success rate joins via node_id.","Deterministic nodes (test, human_gate) produce ledger rows with agent_id 'test-runner'/model 'none' and trace node.completed events but have no entry in agents.json - they must be excluded from role stats (no role), which is exactly the desired behaviour.","Retries push a new AgentDefinition per attempt for the same node_id (same role, since role is derived from node_type in factory.ts ROLE map), so node_id -> role stays unambiguous; invocation counts naturally include retries.","ContextLedgerEntry has 32 keys, all primitives (string/number/boolean) - no nested objects - so CSV serialisation is straightforward and a fixed ordered column list with a compile-time exhaustiveness check is safe.","tsconfig has erasableSyntaxOnly + verbatimModuleSyntax + allowImportingTsExtensions: imports must use `.ts` extensions, type-only imports must use `import type`, and no enums/parameter properties (static class fields with initialisers are fine).","Existing tests use node:test + node:assert/strict and tests/helpers.ts (tmp(), task(), fakeRepo()); MockRuntime makes a real end-to-end Orchestrator run cheap, which enables a format-compatibility integration test for the registry."],"decisions":["Create src/ledger-csv.ts exporting `LEDGER_COLUMNS` (readonly ordered tuple of the 32 ContextLedgerEntry keys), `csvEscape(v: unknown): string` (internal or exported) and `ledgerToCsv(rows: ContextLedgerEntry[]): string`. Add a compile-time guard `type _Missing = Exclude<keyof ContextLedgerEntry, typeof LEDGER_COLUMNS[number]>; const _check: never = undefined as unknown as _Missing;` so a future field added to the interface breaks typecheck instead of silently dropping a column.","CSV rules: quote a field iff it contains ',' '\"' '\\n' or '\\r'; escape embedded quotes by doubling; numbers via String(), booleans as true/false, null/undefined as empty; rows joined with '\\n' and NO trailing newline (header-only output === LEDGER_COLUMNS.join(',')).","Create src/registry.ts exporting interfaces `RoleStats`, `PromotionCandidate`, `RegistryFile` and class `SpecialistRegistry` with: `ingestRun(dir: string): void`, `ingestRuns(dirs: string[]): void`, `static findRunDirs(root: string): string[]`, `roles(): RoleStats[]`, `candidates(): PromotionCandidate[]`, `toJSON(): RegistryFile`, `save(file: string): void`, `static load(file: string): SpecialistRegistry`, `table(): string`. Thresholds as static readonly fields MIN_INVOCATIONS = 3, MIN_SUCCESS_RATE = 0.8.","RoleStats shape: { role, invocations, agents (distinct agent_ids), runs (run dir basenames), nodes_completed, nodes_failed, success_rate, total_cost_usd, total_input_tokens, total_output_tokens, mean_cost_usd, mean_input_tokens, mean_output_tokens, models[] }. Totals are persisted alongside means so save/load is lossless and further ingestRun() calls can keep accumulating after a load.","Aggregation semantics: invocations = ledger rows whose agent_id resolves to a role (excludes deterministic rows); success_rate = nodes_completed / (nodes_completed + nodes_failed), 0 when the denominator is 0; models = sorted unique ledger `model` values excluding 'none'; means = totals / invocations, 0 when invocations is 0.","Promotion is suggestion-only: candidates() is a pure derivation (invocations >= 3 && success_rate >= 0.8), each candidate carries `status: 'candidate'` and a human-readable `reason` e.g. \"Planning Architect: 4 invocations, 100% node success (4/4), mean $0.0123 / 1,200 in / 300 out tokens on haiku - suggest registering as a reusable specialist (human approval required).\" No API mutates agents.json or AgentDefinition; the registry only reads files.","findRunDirs(root): read root's entries; if root itself contains agents.json include it; otherwise recurse one to two levels (enough for runs/<exp-id>/<mode>) collecting every directory that contains agents.json, sorted, skipping node_modules/.git/workspace/invocations. ingestRun throws on missing agents.json; missing or malformed ledger.jsonl / trace.jsonl are tolerated as empty (JSONL parsed line-by-line, blank lines skipped).","CLI: add `runs: { type: \"string\" }` to the existing parseArgs options, a `registry` branch (`registry --runs <dir> [--out registry.json]`) that does SpecialistRegistry.findRunDirs(resolve(v.runs!)) -> ingestRuns -> console.log(reg.table()) -> reg.save(resolve(v.out)) only when --out is given, plus one USAGE line. Nothing else in cli.ts changes.","table() renders a dependency-free fixed-width ASCII table (columns: role, invocations, success, mean $, mean in, mean out, models) followed by a 'Promotion candidates (suggestions only)' section; column widths computed from content.","Tests: tests/ledger-csv.test.ts (header order/completeness, value ordering against a synthetic full entry, comma/quote/newline escaping, booleans+numbers, empty input = header only) and tests/registry.test.ts (fixture run dirs written to tmp(); multi-run aggregation, success rate from node.completed vs node.failed, candidate thresholds incl. 2-invocation and 0.5-success negatives, reason text, save/load round-trip deep-equality, agents.json byte-identical after ingest, findRunDirs skipping non-run dirs, plus one integration test that runs Orchestrator with MockRuntime and ingests its real out_dir)."],"assumptions":["ContextLedgerEntry stays flat (all primitive fields); if a nested field is ever added, ledgerToCsv would need a JSON.stringify fallback (the planned `csvEscape(v: unknown)` already degrades gracefully via String()).","Role is stable per node_type (factory.ts ROLE map), so node_id -> role from agents.json has no conflicts; if two roles ever shared a node_id the last one in agents.json wins.","Control-mode run dirs contain no agents.json and are therefore correctly skipped by findRunDirs.","Run directory layout under --runs is at most two levels deep (runs/<experiment-id>/<mode>); deeper nesting would need the recursion depth bumped.","npx tsc --noEmit and node --test tests/*.test.ts are already green on the current tree, so the only new typecheck risk is the two new modules and their tests."],"questions":["Should `registry --runs` default to writing registry.json when --out is omitted? Plan assumes print-only unless --out is given.","Should the CSV exporter also be surfaced as a CLI flag (e.g. `report --csv`)? Objective does not ask for it, so plan leaves it library-only to keep the diff minimal.","Is a trailing newline expected at the end of ledgerToCsv output? Plan chooses no trailing newline for testability."],"files_changed":[],"need_context":[]}

{"summary":"Implemented part (B) of the objective: src/ledger-csv.ts exporting LEDGER_COLUMNS, csvEscape and ledgerToCsv, plus tests/ledger-csv.test.ts with six node:test cases. CSV quoting follows RFC 4180 (quote iff the field contains a comma, double-quote, LF or CR; embedded quotes doubled), numbers/booleans stringify bare, null/undefined become empty, rows join with \\n and there is no trailing newline. The compile-time exhaustiveness guard was verified by deleting a column and observing tsc fail with TS2322. Full repo typecheck is clean and the whole suite passes 29/29; only the two new files exist in the working tree (cli.ts untouched, as instructed).","verdict":"pass","findings":["ContextLedgerEntry has 30 fields, not the 32 stated in the plan handoff. LEDGER_COLUMNS therefore has 30 entries; a test asserts deepEqual against Object.keys() of a fully-populated entry so the count stays self-checking.","All 30 fields are primitives (string | number | boolean | ExecutionMode), so no JSON.stringify fallback is needed today; csvEscape(v: unknown) degrades via String() if a nested field is ever added.","The compile-time guard works as intended: removing the \"ts\" column makes tsc emit `src/ledger-csv.ts(45,7): error TS2322: Type '\"ts\"' is not assignable to type 'never'`. Verified by temporary mutation and restore.","`as const satisfies readonly (keyof ContextLedgerEntry)[]` covers the reverse direction (a typo'd or stale column name fails to compile) without needing a second never-assignment.","erasableSyntaxOnly/verbatimModuleSyntax constraints are honoured: `import type` for ContextLedgerEntry, .ts import extension, no enums, no parameter properties, no classes.","Baseline confirmed green before and after the change: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json exits 0, node --test tests/*.test.ts reports 29 pass / 0 fail."],"decisions":["Column order is the declaration order of ContextLedgerEntry in src/types.ts (30 columns), keeping CSV diffs stable across runs.","Kept the accepted `const _check: never` guard form rather than a purely type-level assertion, and added `void _check;` so the binding is unambiguously used; runtime cost is one erased-type const.","csvEscape is exported (not module-private) so the escaping rules are directly unit-testable and reusable by a future CLI flag.","ledgerToCsv emits no trailing newline; header-only output is exactly LEDGER_COLUMNS.join(','), as decided in the plan.","Test suite includes a ~20-line RFC 4180 reader used only as an oracle, proving the writer is round-trippable rather than only asserting literal strings."],"assumptions":["Consumers wanting a POSIX-style trailing newline will add it at the write site (e.g. writeFileSync(f, ledgerToCsv(rows) + \"\\n\")); the library deliberately does not.","No BOM is emitted, so Excel on Windows may mis-detect UTF-8 in non-ASCII node objectives. Acceptable for a telemetry export consumed by scripts/pandas.","Row separator is LF, not the CRLF strict RFC 4180 prescribes; escaping still quotes any field containing CR or LF, so output stays unambiguous for standard parsers.","ContextLedgerEntry remains flat; a nested field would render as [object Object] until a JSON.stringify branch is added to csvEscape."],"questions":["The plan handoff said ContextLedgerEntry has 32 keys; the actual interface has 30. Confirm no ledger fields were expected to land as part of this change (the guard will catch future additions at compile time).","Should the CSV exporter be surfaced via CLI (e.g. `report --csv`)? Left library-only per the plan to keep the diff minimal.","Trailing newline: chosen as 'none' for testability - flag if downstream tooling expects one."],"files_changed":["src/ledger-csv.ts (new)","tests/ledger-csv.test.ts (new)"],"need_context":[]}

{"summary":"Implemented Part (A): src/registry.ts with a read-only SpecialistRegistry that ingests run directories (agents.json + ledger.jsonl + trace.jsonl), aggregates per-role stats (invocations, node success rate from node.completed vs node.failed, totals + means for cost/input/output tokens, distinct agents/runs/models), derives suggestion-only promotion candidates (>=3 invocations, >=0.8 success) with a human-readable reason, and supports save/load of registry.json plus an ASCII table(). Wired an additive `registry --runs <dir> [--out registry.json]` branch (+ `runs` parseArgs option and one USAGE line) into src/cli.ts. Added tests/registry.test.ts (12 tests) covering multi-run aggregation, success-rate derivation, both negative threshold cases, reason text, lossless save/load round-trip with continued accumulation, double-ingest guard, artifact immutability, findRunDirs filtering, error/malformed-input tolerance, table rendering, and an end-to-end ingest of a real Orchestrator+MockRuntime run. `node --test tests/*.test.ts` => 41/41 pass (includes the parallel agent's 6 ledger-csv tests); `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` clean. Nothing committed.","verdict":"pass","findings":["Part (B) files (src/ledger-csv.ts, tests/ledger-csv.test.ts) were already present in the workspace from parallel work; I did not touch them. They pass standalone (6 tests) and in the combined run.","Deterministic nodes (test runner / human gate) emit ledger rows with agent_id 'test-runner' and model 'none' that have no agents.json entry, so they are naturally excluded from role stats; verified by test.","Orchestrator's agents.json drops system_prompt (JSON.stringify(undefined)), so the registry reads a loose AgentRecord shape ({agent_id, role, node_id, model}) instead of importing AgentDefinition, avoiding a type mismatch.","Real orchestrator run: 3 roles x 1 invocation each, all at 100% success and therefore below the promotion threshold — confirms candidates() stays empty on a single run, as intended.","No changes needed to src/types.ts, src/ledger.ts or src/orchestrator.ts; ContextLedgerEntry and TraceEvent were already exported."],"decisions":["src/registry.ts exports RoleStats, PromotionCandidate, RegistryFile and class SpecialistRegistry with ingestRun/ingestRuns/static findRunDirs/roles/candidates/runs/toJSON/save/static load/table/static reasonFor, plus static MIN_INVOCATIONS=3 and MIN_SUCCESS_RATE=0.8.","Totals (total_cost_usd/total_input_tokens/total_output_tokens, nodes_completed/nodes_failed) are persisted and means/success_rate are recomputed in a private finalize(), making save/load lossless and allowing a loaded registry to keep ingesting further runs.","ingestRun is idempotent per resolved absolute directory (a private ingested Set), so a repeated or overlapping scan never double-counts.","ingestRun throws on a missing agents.json; malformed agents.json and missing/malformed ledger.jsonl or trace.jsonl are tolerated as empty (JSONL parsed line-by-line, blank/bad lines skipped).","findRunDirs walks up to depth 3 from root, returns a directory as soon as it contains agents.json (never descending into it), skips node_modules/.git/workspace/invocations, returns [] for a nonexistent root, and returns a sorted list.","save() returns the written RegistryFile and mkdirs the parent directory; the CLI only writes when --out is passed (print-only otherwise) and defaults --runs to ./runs.","Thousands separators and percentages are formatted manually (regex + Math.round) rather than via toLocaleString, to keep output locale-independent and test-stable.","Promotion remains advisory: candidates() is a pure derivation over roles(), each candidate carries status:'candidate' and a reason ending in '(human approval required)'; no code path writes to agents.json (asserted byte-identical in a test)."],"assumptions":["Role is stable per node_id within a run (factory.ts derives role from node_type), so node_id -> role from agents.json is unambiguous; if two roles ever shared a node_id, the last agents.json entry wins.","Run directory nesting under --runs is at most ~3 levels (runs/<experiment-id>/<mode>); deeper layouts need the depth bumped in findRunDirs.","ContextLedgerEntry.estimated_cost_usd / input_tokens / output_tokens are the right cost and token fields for 'mean cost / mean input / mean output' (cache tokens are deliberately not folded in).","Roles are keyed by the human-readable role string from agents.json; if factory.ts ROLE labels are renamed, historical registry.json entries will not merge with new runs.","The parallel agent's src/ledger-csv.ts and tests/ledger-csv.test.ts are final; I only ran them, so a later rewrite there is outside my verification."],"questions":["Should `registry --runs` write registry.json by default when --out is omitted? Implemented as print-only unless --out is given.","Should candidate roles be scoped per model (e.g. 'Planning Architect on haiku') rather than aggregated across models? Currently models are merged into one row per role.","Should the registry expose a CLI flag to filter by mode or experiment id once many runs accumulate?"],"files_changed":["src/registry.ts (new)","tests/registry.test.ts (new)","src/cli.ts (modified: registry import, USAGE line, `runs` option, registry command branch)"],"need_context":[]}
